instructions: Start each objective with relai_work action begin and pass its work_id to later calls. Inspect relevant files before editing; use bounded reads and commands. Validate after changes. On edit failure, follow recovery guidance and retry; report unavailable only after a separate availability check fails. Never bypass approval, workspace, task, or destructive-operation safeguards. Report only checks actually run. Finish with relai_work action finish after review.

tools.description: Run one-shot workspace commands. Prefer executable + argv for shell-free execution; use command only for shell syntax.

inputSchema.description: Choose one mode. Prefer direct executable + argv mode by default; use command only for deliberate shell parsing.

argv.description: Arguments passed without shell parsing; keep each logical argument separate.

command.description: Shell command. Use only for shell syntax. Do not embed JavaScript, Python, JSON, patches, or multiline scripts.

executable.description: Executable launched with shell:false; preferred for structured arguments.

input.description: Literal stdin for multiline scripts or structured text; preserves quote-sensitive content.

tools.title: Run Command
